subject: Re: Contract term + capacity — vendor bakeoff underway
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan@olive-sys.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@olivesystems.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal — bakeoff with EdgeBench

Neha,

Quick update from our side before the renewal conversation next month. We’ve run an initial internal eval and procurement has requested a competitive bakeoff — EdgeBench reached out and has proposed a proof-of-performance for inference latency/cost that they say will beat our current run rates.

We value Redwood’s reliability, but procurement wants hard numbers (latency p95 across 3 workloads, cost per 1k tokens at our traffic profile, and a short pilot for dedicated capacity). Can your team run a matched bench and provide an AM/PM slot this week for a sync to align on scope?

Also include your updated pricing for the dedicated pool and any short-term term/pricing options. Evan

--
Evan Park
VP Product Operations | Olive Systems

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan@olive-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — bakeoff with EdgeBench

Evan — thanks for the heads up and for being candid. Important context for us.

Short answer: yes, we can run a side-by-side bench and set up a 72-hour dedicated pilot that mirrors your traffic slice. We’ll include p95 latency, token cost estimates with and without KV/prefix caching, and a throughput profile for your peak 30-minute window.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll loop in Karthik (solutions) and Marissa (CS lead) to scope the pilot and confirm what workloads you want matched.
- We’ll share a quick mutual action plan (MAP) outlining responsibilities, dates, and acceptance criteria; drafting now.
- For pricing: I’ve attached the most recent dedicated pricing and a short-term repricing sheet we can offer for a 12-month extension if pilot results meet expectations.

Can we block 30 mins tomorrow at 11:30 PT for scope?

Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0196

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v3.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Upcoming renewal — bakeoff with EdgeBench

Forwarding Evan’s note — adding Grace for product ops/bench support and Karthik for pilot scoping.

Marissa here — quick thoughts:
- We should insist on a controlled bench vs. public claims. Ask for their test scripts (we can map to our workload) and request that both vendors run the same seed workloads and the same tokenization.
- Offer a canary lane on our Dedicated pool with fixed capacity for the 72-hour run to show deterministic latency.
- Include an SLA uplift for the term extension to make switching costs material (SLO credits, faster incident response).

Karthik — can you draft the bench run instructions and a minimal acceptance rubric? Grace — can you confirm available capacity for 10/24-10/27?

-M

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-22T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — bench scope and runbook

All — draft attached: "poa-benchrun-instructions.md" and an "olive-bakeoff-map.xlsx" that maps Olive’s three primary workloads to our test harness. Key elements:
- Fixed input corpus (sanitized) + prompt templates to ensure determinism
- KV cache enabled/disabled permutations to show cost delta
- Throughput stress test for peak 30-min window
- Measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/second, cost-per-1k tokens (est), memory/VRAM usage

Acceptance rubric (short):
1) p95 within 10% of EdgeBench’s claimed p95 OR cost-per-1k tokens > 15% better than EdgeBench
2) No regressions in hallucination rate on a 200-example prompt set
3) Successful warm start on our Dedicated pool within 60s

I’ll own the runbook and coordinate with Grace on capacity.

-Karthik

Attachments: poa-benchrun-instructions.md, olive-bakeoff-map.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan@olive-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@olivesystems.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood bench plan + MAP for Olive Systems (OLV-4829)

Evan — thanks again. Attached is the mutual action plan and bench instructions (short). High level:
- 72-hour dedicated pilot on a fixed 4x GPU pool on 10/25–10/28 (can compress to 48 hours if you prefer)
- We’ll run the three workloads you flagged and produce a calibrated report with p95/p99, cost estimates both at your current throughput and scaled 2x traffic.
- Offer: if Redwood meets the acceptance rubric, we will extend a 12-month priced term at a 10% discount off list for Dedicated plus a guaranteed 10% uplift in incident response SLA (1-hour P1 target).

Action items for Olive:
1) Approve MAP and return with approval by 10/24 EOD
2) Share the specific dataset seeds and any compliance constraints (PII redaction)

If you approve, we’ll provision the lanes tonight and send credentials.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v3.pdf, poa-benchrun-instructions.md

Neha — appreciate the speed here. Procurement has reviewed the MAP and the pilot scope looks good. Approved to proceed with the 72-hour lane 10/25–10/28.

We will send the dataset seeds and a signed MAP by EOD. A couple of clarifying Qs:
- Can Redwood commit to isolated telemetry for the pilot (we need raw p95 logs for our auditors)?
- Will the 10% discount be applied retroactively to usage during the first 30 days after signing?

Copying Sanjay from EdgeBench for transparency; they’ve accepted the same bench rules so both vendors will run the identical harness.

Thanks — Evan
